prestige.hall_intro: Here, you can transcend the limits of an ordinary adventurer and be reborn!
prestige.rule_1: 1. Prestige resets your level to Lv.1, EXP to zero, and resets stat allocation.
prestige.rule_2: 2. After prestiging, you'll gain 1 permanent passive bonus tier, adding +10% to all combat stats!
prestige.rule_3: 3. Prestige unequips your weapon, armor, and accessory, and resets your current Demon Tower / Dungeon floor (earned milestone medals and trophies will not be lost).
prestige.rule_4: 4. Prestige does not clear your bag items, gold, or learned skills.
prestige.rule_5: 5. Each prestige raises the level required for your next one.
prestige.success:
🌟 Congratulations, you've been reborn! You're back to Lv.1 and have permanently gained +{bonus}% to all stats!
(Demon Tower/Dungeon floors have been reset, weapon/armor/accessory unequipped)

tutorial.prompt:
👋 Looks like this is your first time in this world!
Want to spend a minute on the tutorial to learn how the battle panel works?
tutorial.skipped: Alright! You can always find the village chief for a chat — he knows a surprising amount. Good luck out there!
tutorial.tip_action_bar:
📖 **Battle Tutorial 2/6 — Action Bar & Speed**
The ⚡ action bar fills up based on both sides' SPD (speed) — once it's full, that side gets to act. Higher speed fills the bar faster, meaning more actions overall.
tutorial.tip_defend_flee:
📖 **Battle Tutorial 6/6 — Defend / Dodge / Flee**
"Defend" halves the damage you take this turn; "Dodge" has a chance to avoid an attack entirely (higher speed = higher odds); and if the fight's not going your way, "Flee" — success chance also depends on the speed difference.
tutorial.tip_element:
📖 **Battle Tutorial 4/6 — Elemental Matchups**
Weapons and skills can carry elements like fire/ice/thunder. Hitting a weakness shows 🌟[Super Effective], hitting a resistance shows 🛡️[Not Very Effective], and full immunity shows 👻[No Effect]. Finding an enemy's weakness can massively boost your damage!
tutorial.tip_skill_item:
📖 **Battle Tutorial 5/6 — Skills & Items**
Learn skills at the ⛪Church using scrolls, then "Configure" them into your battle slots to use the "Skill" button in combat (costs MP or HP). The "Item" button lets you drink potions to heal/restore MP, or cure status effects.
tutorial.tip_stats:
📖 **Battle Tutorial 1/6 — Your Stats**
The top of the panel shows your ❤️HP, 💧MP, ⚔️ATK, 🛡️DEF, and 🚀SPD. HP hitting 0 means defeat; MP is spent to cast skills.

Click the "Attack" button below and take a swing at the training dummy!
tutorial.tip_warning:
📖 **Battle Tutorial 3/6 — ❗ Warning Marks**
If ❗ appears next to an enemy's name, the system is predicting how many times it will attack before your next turn (more ❗ = more danger). Seeing ❗❗❗? Consider defending or finishing it off fast!
